name: OneTrust
description: OneTrust is a governance, risk, and compliance platform that unifies privacy management, AI governance, third-party risk management, and technology risk/compliance into one system for enterprise trust and compliance programs.
best_for: Large enterprises needing a single platform to manage privacy, AI governance, third-party vendor risk, and broader technology risk/compliance programs across multiple regulatory frameworks.
features: AI Governance module managing compliance and controls across the AI lifecycle
Consent & Preferences management for consumer transparency and consent
Data Use Governance enforcing real-time policy compliance for how data is used
Privacy Automation for responsible data lifecycle management
Tech Risk & Compliance for enterprise risk and compliance process management
Third-Party Management automating vendor assessment and monitoring
Solutions organized by regulatory framework, including GDPR, US state privacy laws, and the EU AI Act
pros: Six distinct modules (AI Governance, Consent & Preferences, Data Use Governance, Privacy Automation, Tech Risk & Compliance, Third-Party Management) under one platform rather than separate point solutions
Solutions are organized both by team/role and by regulatory framework, which can shorten navigation for a specific compliance need
cons: No published pricing for any module -- every plan uses custom usage-based meters (admin users, inventory size, visitor volume, or data-subject profiles) quoted through sales
Breadth across six modules means teams needing only focused SOC 2/ISO 27001 audit-readiness automation may find a narrower tool simpler to adopt

tiers.name: AI Governance / Tech Risk & Compliance / Third-Party Management
tiers.notes: Priced on admin users plus asset/AI/third-party inventory size, per OneTrust's pricing page. No public dollar figure.

tiers.name: Universal Consent & Preference Management
tiers.notes: Priced on total data-subject profiles captured. No public dollar figure.

tiers.name: Consent Management Platform (Base/Suite)
tiers.notes: Priced on average daily visitors aggregated across channels and properties. No public dollar figure.

tiers.name: Privacy Automation (Base/Suite)
tiers.notes: Priced on users and privacy asset inventory. No public dollar figure.

alternatives.name: Vanta
alternatives.description: A compliance and trust automation platform that continuously monitors security controls and automates evidence collection to help organizations earn certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a focused, integration-based audit-readiness tool rather than a full enterprise privacy/GRC suite.
strengths: Automated evidence collection from 400+ integrated tools

alternatives.name: Drata
alternatives.description: A compliance automation platform for continuous control monitoring and evidence collection across frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting to map controls once and reuse them across many audit frameworks, rather than adopt a broader enterprise GRC suite.
strengths: Trust Center built into the core platform

faq.question: Is OneTrust the same kind of tool as Vanta or Drata?
faq.answer: Not exactly. OneTrust is a broader enterprise governance suite spanning privacy, AI governance, and third-party/tech risk, while Vanta and Drata focus specifically on automating evidence collection and continuous monitoring for audit frameworks like SOC 2 and ISO 27001. OneTrust's own Tech Risk & Compliance and Third-Party Management modules overlap with that use case, but as part of a larger platform rather than a standalone audit-automation product.
